title: The UNTHINKABLE is About to Happen to Stocks (but most will invest wrong)
speaker: Tom Nash

macro_themes.view: Earnings keep rising every quarter, so ignore crash talk; worry only when earnings turn south.
Mostly education/promo: trim and double-down DCA rules (double buys when index is 10%+ off its 1-year high, stocks 20%+), 125-point quality test.

calls.reason: Earnings rising each quarter; 'if earnings keep increasing... stocks will go up'. Acknowledges crashes happen but buys dips.
calls.quote: If earnings keep increasing, stocks are businesses. That means stocks will go up.

calls.reason: 40% of his portfolio; stock back at all-time highs ~209 after 137 low in 2026; holds for long-term compounding, earlier '500 in a few years' thesis.
calls.quote: Now it's back at all time highs at 209.

notes: Largely an education/promo video for a free masterclass Sat Oct 17 2pm ET. No near-term levels or CPI/OpEx view. Portfolio 40% PLTR / 40% S&P 500 / 20% TSLA. Past picks cited (NVDA, DDOG, BE) as track record, not new calls.
